Furthermore, the Online Companion only notes that several of the Cassander sector [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] were a part of the Tadrin and Tendrannan sectors but does not explicitly mention the [[Cassander subsector]], which {{CSWECite|I|111|Cassandran Worlds}} establishes as encompassing a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] that became one of the three constituent parts of what ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identified as the Cassander sector. Therefore, this article assumes that Cassander sector systems not assigned a specific subsector by the Online Companion, which includes the Peldon Minor system, were situated in the Cassander subsector.</ref>

The '''Peldon Minor system''' was located in the [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] that eventually became the [[Cassander subsector]],<ref name="Cassander" /> a part of the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Peldon Minor]], which saw [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] actions during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Peldon Minor [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
